name: Atlas v12 prediction-stratified interval development

protocol.champion: atlas v11 symmetric crop/history radii and crop-region scales
protocol.candidate: retain v11 80% radii; blend v11 90% radii toward crop/history/prediction-band conformal radii
protocol.rule: Require >=100 calibration examples per conditional cell, pooled/crop/region 90% coverage on development and stability, unchanged 80% intervals, and >=1% narrower mean 90% intervals on both blocks; select the passing candidate with the largest stability reduction.

interpretation: Observed county-rank uncertainty; not parcel yield, revenue, or property value.
